nodes.label: AI Service Python Dependencies
nodes.rationale: fastapi/uvicorn, inngest pinned >=0.5.19,<0.6.0 to avoid breaking SDK changes, qdrant-client, llama-index + readers-file, pydantic/pydantic-settings, openai, httpx, tenacity for retries, structlog for structured logs and numpy. Note FlagEmbedding (local BGE-M3) is referenced in the docs but absent here, so EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=local needs an extra install.
